description:
As a DHIS2 Administrator, you need to extend the data model to capture infrastructure details for health facilities. 

1. Go to the Maintenance app > Other > Attributes.
2. Create a new Attribute named 'Generator Functional'. Set 'Value type' to 'Yes/No' and assign it to 'Organisation unit'. Save it.
3. Create another Attribute named 'Distance to District Office (km)'. Set 'Value type' to 'Positive Integer' (or Integer) and assign it to 'Organisation unit'. Save it.
4. Go to the Organisation Unit section in Maintenance.
5. Search for 'Bo Govt Hospital'.
6. Edit the facility and scroll to the Attributes section.
7. Set 'Generator Functional' to 'Yes' and 'Distance to District Office (km)' to '15'.
8. Save the Organisation Unit.
